text: Deadlines are a part of professional life, and handling them well is a valuable skill. Good time management is the foundation, meaning you break large tasks into smaller, manageable steps and schedule them on a calendar. Equally important is prioritization; not every task is urgent, so you must focus on what is most critical first. Remember the principle of scope management: it’s easy to keep adding extra features or details, but this often causes delays. If you feel overwhelmed, communicate early with your team or client. Simply explaining that you need more time or fewer tasks is far better than missing the deadline entirely. In the end, clear communication and a realistic plan are your best tools for success.
